title: EyeLevel Launch: Your RAG is Tripping, Here's the Real Reason Why
talk_summary: A vendor pitch for EyeLevel's RAG platform arguing that most RAG errors come from ingestion (bad extraction, lost chunk context, unextracted visuals), not LLMs or prompts. Their fix is a vision-model ingestion pipeline producing 'semantic objects' with auto-generated metadata, dual search/completion text rewrites, multi-field search, and LLM re-ranking.

takeaways.technique: Preserve surrounding context in chunks (semantic objects)
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of bare text chunks, they store each chunk with auto-generated metadata capturing section/document provenance and rewrite text into separate search-optimized and completion-optimized versions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: It consists of the original chunk text as well as auto-generated metadata that preserves the information around the text.

takeaways.technique: LLM re-rank retrieved results before use
takeaways.what_they_do: After multi-field search they run a fine-tuned LLM re-ranker over candidates to improve relevance before feeding the completion model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Use a fine-tuned LLM to re-rank the results and improve the accuracy.

takeaways.what_they_do: A fine-tuned vision model locates images/tables/text, then dedicated multimodal pipelines extract them so visual content isn't lost.
takeaways.evidence_quote: run a vision model that we fine-tune with millions of documents to identify where the images, the tables, and the text are
